text:
The repaired Reading B schedule is real, and the prior high signature-message defect is closed. The packet is not an exact implementation freeze: several frozen first-failure oracles still contradict that schedule. It does not close W-D2, W-D2E, or Sprint 1. No consumer was executed in the packet or in this review.

This is one Grok 4.7 review of the embedded bytes. Printed SHA-256 labels agree across the manifest, file banners, and `freeze-receipt.json`. They were not recomputed.

## Verdict

Use this packet as the design direction for a future bound adapter. Do not treat `EXPECTATIONS.json` as a byte-exact oracle until the medium locus bugs below are repaired. B01–B17 stay open. Local success, if it is ever reached, stays `SemanticComparedUnqualified` with B17 pending. Ledger acceptance is a separate later mode.

Counts in the embedded matrix match the receipt: header plus 35 signed fields, 14 nested operation fields, 6 specified-only positives, 132 hostile ids, 10 inspection ids, 17 bindings. All six positive lengths and commitments match the embedded W-D2E fixtures (`583/bc633665…`, `560/ed5b4bff…`, `688/e8b64f93…`, `688/90b113d7…`, `688/006f01a1…`, `688/f0889508…`). Accrual-first post-states match Core/5 (`da = min(n, accrued)`, zero-fee credit omitted, zero-fee footprint kept, one work unit, composite replay append). `actionId` on those authorizations is still `Action`, so they are not full Source positives.

`implementationExists`, `consumerTestsExecuted`, `observedLocalSemanticComparisons`, and `observedFullConsumerSuccesses` are all false or zero. Every hostile row is `specified-only-not-executed`.

## Prior findings

The anchor/late-field defect is closed in the normative schedule. Provider integrity is at the anchor; signed equality is at that field’s own tag. The matrix now pins the cases that used to fire too early:

- B04 retains the Core id at tag 6 and compares it at tag 10.
- B08 retains the authorized key at tag 13; B09 may use that key at tag 14; `signerKey` equality is tag 15.
- B10 anchors on `asset` at tag 16; scale equality is tag 17.
- B11 does not compare debtor, creditor, or field 19 at tag 18.
- Same-tag literals run before provider lookup (`agreement-literal-before-provider`).
- A late domain failure beats unavailable B01; a late in-domain mismatch does not.

The signature-message defect is closed. B09 preprocessing is unselected. SHA-256 of the canonical authorization is named only as the wire content digest. `invalid-signature` expects `EvidenceRejected` / `W_D2F_EVIDENCE_INVALID` / B09 and does not fix message bytes.

The earlier missing controls are mostly present: `schnorr_bip340`, F-S0-01, supplied `replayAfter` and both-array overflow with `replayBefore` first, `imageSide`, distinct head `sourcePath`s, equal-looking `keyRef`, invalid B12/B13/B14/B16, wire scale 19 and 38 against Source 18, Source validity past `2^64-1`, and isolated Core intent cap, round, and alias results. Those Core rows match the embedded preparer, including `S0_INTENT_ALIAS` only after the stage checks fail to fire, and `S0_INTENT_SCOPE` before `sameEffects`.

Reading B is consistent in `PLAN.md`, `FIELD-MAP.md`, `EXPECTATIONS.json`, `RESULT.md`, and the receipt. B01–B16 are local-comparison prerequisites. B17 is pending after E and rejects only requested L mode. The six positives list blockers B01–B16, not B17.

## Remaining mediums

1. `genuine-different-snapshot-head` invents a Source discrepancy. The mutation says wire, `intent.preHead`, and `authenticated.head` are all `55`, while a real B11 proof authenticates head `bb`. The oracle then sets `sourcePath` to `authenticated.head`. That path is the claim-mismatch locus used by `prehead-snapshot-claim-before-evidence`. Here the claim matches the wire. The failing pair is signed `preHead` versus `B11.snapshot.head`. `factPath` is the right locus; `sourcePath` is not. Fact-mismatch rows also alternate between `binding` and `retainedFactBinding`.

2. `invalid-evidence-b12`, `b13`, and `b14` reuse the precondition “including unsigned tail for B16”. Those anchors are tags 19, 20, and 23. The unsigned tail is after tag 35. A literal reading of those preconditions puts the tail before the anchor and reopens the late-field bug the schedule just closed. The same sentence is right only for B16.

3. The two AdvanceHead domain oracles freeze `effects[5]`. That index is the AdvanceHead line for fee transfer and for repay (six submitted lines). Zero-fee transfer omits the fee credit, so AdvanceHead is `effects[4]`, matching the zero-fee positive vector in this packet. `FIELD-MAP.md` says `effects[i]`. The frozen `[5]` is wrong for one of the six shapes.

4. The Core handoff still allows the history shortcut the sprint exists to forbid. `lowerSource6` sets `consumedReplay` to `[]` or `[selected key]` from the Source `unused`/`consumed` claim, and it rewrites `UseReplay` into `JSON.stringify([domain, signer, effect.key])`. `PLAN.md` says C takes the verified snapshot plus submitted Source effects. It never gives one constructor that copies the lowerer’s composite `UseReplay` key, replaces `consumedReplay` with the B16 history, and calls `prepareMil4S0`. `prepareSource6S0Unqualified` is the wrong entry: on success it republishes agreement, program, scale, and predecessor as unverified, and if the actions differ it overwrites a non-stage Core rejection with `S0_INTENT_SCOPE`.

5. B13 does not keep the split just adopted for B11. A genuine proof of a different head is `FIELD_MISMATCH`; a proof that fails is `EVIDENCE_INVALID`. `PLAN.md` instead calls selected-key reuse a B13 evidence failure. There is no oracle for a valid proof that the key is already consumed. There is also no oracle for Source `replay consumed` against an authenticated history that does not contain that key. Both are first-failure gaps on the history obligation.

6. F-S0-01 is pinned (`success_only` corresponds to `atomic-reject-terminal-success`, `directLiteralEquality: false`, normative W-D2 not adopted). Profile and version are the same kind of cross-vocabulary pair and are not pinned that way: wire `s0-provisional/1`, header `moriarty-intent/3`, Source `moriarty-financial-agreement-source/6`, Core `moriarty-core/5`. Each parser already accepts only its own literal. A tag-1 string compare would reject every well-formed pair before B01 and would falsify `fullConsumerExpectedNow`. The field table says “profile compatibility” and “correspond by version” without a selected rule.

`authenticatedSnapshot` on the proposed API is the same class of hazard. The packet’s own rule is that a caller snapshot, boolean, tuple, or receipt is not B11. The parameter name reads as an already-authenticated snapshot. Evidence inputs need a proof-object type, not a cell bag.

Lower-severity gaps, not gate blockers by themselves: tag 26 is deferred to E inside an M scan that says “tags 1–35” without an exception list; if two retained facts disagree at one later tag, the reported binding id is unspecified; `PLAN.md` step H omits `imageSide` while the matrix sets `derived`; the inclusive `2^64-1` endpoint is prose-only; the receipt does not cite prior bundle `10c432ea…`; history copies named in the receipt are outside these embedded bytes.

## What is already solid

The useful design is the map, not a closure. It keeps literal comparison separate from authentication, refuses to hash the whole self-referential Source document, refuses to treat `Core.intent.programId` as the agreement, refuses to treat fixture `keyRef == signerKey` text as B08, refuses to promote the `Action` authorizations, and hashes only the derived image at E. A rehashed omitted cell dies at I with `W_D2F_PREPARED_IMAGE_MISMATCH`. Replay count above 16 is `EffectDomainRejected`, not a truncated history and not `WireRejected`. Domain sweep completes before M. Isolated Core codes are not promoted to full-path first failures.

W-D2 normative bytes, wallet and Schnorr preprocessing, snapshot proofs, head extension, and atomic consume stay open. F-S0-01 is a local adapter convention for closed S0. Sprint 1 and S1B are outside this packet. The honest next build is still adopted B01–B07 images and identities, then real B08–B16 evidence, then new fixtures. This matrix does not supply those fixtures and does not show a consumer run.
